title: Specialist Feedback Report
description: Strict schema v1.0 for specialist report-back. Orchestrator validates every report against this schema. On first validation failure the orchestrator requests one repair retry with a schema-only JSON prompt; on second failure the lane is marked failed_report_schema, raw output is preserved as a sidecar file in the run artifacts directory (outside this schema), and the lane is treated with status: failed in the run summary.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be '1.0' for this revision.

specialist.description: The lane name of the specialist that produced this report (e.g. 'blazor-component-architect').

status.description: Terminal status of the specialist's work.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence plain-language description of what was done (or why work is blocked/failed).

files_changed.description: All files the specialist touched. Empty array is allowed when no files were changed.

reason.description: Short explanation of why this file was changed.

validation.description: Describes whether and how the specialist validated its own output.

commands.description: Exact commands run. Empty when performed is false.

evidence.description: Short summary of validation outcome. Include first failure signal when result is 'fail'.

next_action.description: Explicit handoff instruction or unblock step for the orchestrator.

token_estimate.description: Optional. Coarse token usage to nearest 100. Omit entirely when not applicable.

self_diagnosis.description: Optional. Include ONLY when --self-improve flag is active.

examples.summary: Extracted OrderSummaryCard and PaymentMethodPicker from Checkout.razor and replaced inline markup with parameterized components.

files_changed.reason: Replaced duplicated markup with component usage.

examples.next_action: Orchestrator can proceed to telemetry artifact generation and final user handoff.
